builder_notes.cli_entrypoint: Exact module/command naming is BuilderAgent's call. INSTRUCTIONS.md AC1 suggests `python -m daily_workshop.run` as an example only.
builder_notes.topic_store_location: Covered-topics store must live inside ./daily_workshop's own data directory (e.g. daily_workshop/data/covered_topics.json) or under workshops/.state/ — never inside the repo's memory/*.json, which is this TDD framework's own unrelated knowledge base.
builder_notes.research_client_choice: Concrete ResearchClient implementation (e.g. Anthropic API with web search, or a dedicated search API) and its API key's exact name in inputs/KEYS.md are BuilderAgent's implementation call. BuilderAgent must add the chosen KEY_NAME=... line and a short explanation to inputs/KEYS.md's existing 'Adding more keys' section during Phase 4/5 — never hardcode the key, never use a .env file (AC10).
builder_notes.seed_topics_backlog: Bootstrap daily_workshop/seed_topics.json with at least 5 entries per domain, using inputs/INSTRUCTIONS.md's 'Seed Topic Backlog' list as the minimum starting set (agentic AI, cloud computing, quantum computing) — list may be expanded freely.
builder_notes.constants_location: Define TARGET_MINUTES, MIN_WORDS, MAX_WORDS, MIN_STEPS, MAX_STEPS, TOPIC_COOLDOWN_DAYS once (suggest models.py or a small constants module) and import everywhere else — never inline duplicates (backend.md anti-pattern rule; REQ-007/REQ-004).
